title: “Moralized” Multi-Step Jailbreak Prompts: Black-Box Testing of Guardrails in Large Language Models for Verbal Attacks
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLM guardrails using a framework of 'moral' jailbreak prompts. It specifically explores how models handle 'moral ambiguity' and 'moral kidnapping'—techniques designed to subvert ethical constraints by framing harmful requests within moral or ethical contexts.
